title: crataegus lassa var. lanata
intro: Crataegus lassa var. lanata, commonly known as the Lanate Hawthorn, is a variety of the hawthorn plant, belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus lassa var. lanata include cardiotonic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as hypertension, angina, and cardiac arrhythmias. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
